newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS cuts rating on Royal Bank Canada E pfd.
newsitem.headline: CBRS cuts rating on Royal Bank Canada E pfd.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday that it cut the rating on Royal Bank of Canada's series E first preferred shares to P-2 from P-1.

The Montreal-based rating agency said it downgraded the preferred shares of Canada's largest bank after Royal Bank said it proposed to amend the C$150 million worth of preferred shares to change the dividends to non-cumulative from cumulative.
CBRS said the rating change was automatic and not a reflection of a change in the underlying credit of Royal Bank.
"It is CBRS's policy to rate non-cumulative preferred shares one full category lower than the cumulative preferred shares," Canadian Bond said.
